text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Born into a lineage of elite athletes, 
Duramente inherited an abundance of 
talent.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She looked up to her parents as ideals, 
and had dedicated herself wholeheartedly 
to training since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, she herself believed that she 
still fell far short of her parents' 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
There was another Umamusume she looked up 
to. The "Empress," Air Groove—an old 
acquaintance who had studied at the same 
racing school as Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Both my parents and Air Groove believe in 
me. To live up to their expectations, I 
must win.
